invariants: Observed requires actual evidence and coverage; a recorded zero is observed Money with minor_units 0, never unknown.
Estimated requires at least one explicitly bounded amount or remains unknown; lower/upper currencies and exponents match the enclosing Economics currency and each other.
Unknown has no amount field and never becomes zero during totals.
No MoneyKnowledge variant is a Grant, Reservation or spendable ResourceAccount; consequential admission requires the kernel actual bounded authority inputs.
Amounts are nonnegative minutes; observed requires timing evidence and coverage.
Estimated is not verified human availability; unknown cannot be counted as unused capacity.

Economics: observed_revenue and observed_cost allow observed or unknown, never estimated presented as actual.
All observed amounts in a currency report match its currency; retain explicit exponent.
Outstanding cost may be observed, estimated or unknown; actual closure_reserve is observed or unknown. A desired closure target remains a separately attributed estimate.
Any unknown input makes the corresponding aggregate incomplete; show known subtotal plus missing categories instead of a complete total.
CashPosition: Each expected account has an AccountBalanceObservation or named coverage gap.
Absent reconciliation date or unknown balance cannot establish zero assets or a current available balance.
Payments bind canonical ResourceAccount/reservation authority and independent native effect evidence, never this account projection alone.
PriceProposal: Price is an exact proposed canonical Money amount, not evidence that a customer accepts it.
Adoption and test exposure require current authority; estimated demand/costs remain attributed in the linked Economics/ObservationSet.
DeliveryCapacity: verified requires actual performer acknowledgment, applicable access/materials, window, resources and continuity evidence; not compute availability.
